evidence_policy.canonical: Raw English and Arabic verse text and their hashes.
evidence_policy.deterministic: Word, stem-family, exact phrase, exact clause, and exact normalized-verse indexes.
evidence_policy.statistical: Lexical, clause-pattern, topic, theme, and association fields are candidates only.
evidence_policy.theme_safety: Theme neighbours are filtered by shared topics, shared content words, and lexical or clause evidence.

corpus_scope.warning: This release contains numbered verses only. Unnumbered Basmalas are not included.

ui_extensions.surface_index: surface-index-en.json (deterministic exact-token fallback and surface-form counts from Rashad English verse text)
